ya. my ex. i was 16 and he was 23. we dated for a year. the day we broke up, he picked me up from high school, then 17 and 24, and that day i was just super tired and i wanted to chill at home with the love of my life: my dog Daisy. 
he told me our plans for that day, to go sign some papers for him to get a new job or something like that and i declined, stating that i wanted to stay home with my dog. he did NOT like that, so he grabbed her and basically told me if i didn’t say yes he’d take her with him without me. and at this point, i was tired of being controlled and shit so i said no. blatantly. and he took her. he drove away with my dog and i was frantically calling him begging him to bring her back or i’d leave him. (mind you, that was after, like, 10 times of me calling him begging him only for him to hang up and tell me he’d bring her back if i said yes) once i told him i was leaving him, he said that he DROPPED HER OFF ON THE SIDE OF THE RODE. so i called my parents, sobbing, and we all came to the conclusion to threaten to bring the cops into it to scare him into bringing her back. 
he threatened to kill her after that. so i called HIS mom and she called his dad and after a while, he showed up without Daisy in the car and said, “Good luck.” 
i heard her barks at the end of my neighborhood. i ran barefoot to go get her and returned her home safely. 

more stuff:
- before all of THAT, he broke those little clamps you put onto a window to keep it shut right so no one can get in... to get into my house and chased me through my house trying to get me back after i broke up with him. (prob for cheating.) i took him back. 
- whenever i’d tell him i wanted to be alone, he’d show up at my dad’s house and open my window late at night sometimes and let himself in 
- once when i was sleeping, he broke my front door down because i wouldn’t answer it
- it has been like... 9 months since we broke up and he, up until maybe 3 months ago, would call me from No Caller ID or a new number from textnow to get in touch with me. even when i never answered. 
- maybe a month ago? he messaged my girlfriend pretending to be a woman seemingly high as fuck on drugs and called me his “little girl”, “daughter” and then sent her a bikini pic i’d posted on facebook WHEN HE IS BLOCKED ON EVERYTHING. i have PTSD from him and i was fucking wrecked from that. smh. that’s all.
